title: Member Note Courtesy Schedule for Finch Circle Tiers, Merchandise Purchases
content:
On a refund of a Finch Note left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, a member's courtesy is set by the tier of the active membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program:

| Active Finch Circle tier | Member note courtesy |
|---|---|
| Diamond or Icon | top member note courtesy, $10.00 |
| Gold or Platinum | middle member note courtesy, $5.00 |

A customer at the Member or Silver tier, or with no active membership, is outside this schedule.

*Hypothetical:* a Platinum member receives $5.00; an Icon member $10.00.
